//: The WebUI is hand-formatted (2-space, single quotes, no semicolons, no line-width wrapping) and linted by ESLint only. This config exists so that Biome-based tooling (e.g. the pi-lens edit hook) does NOT reformat these files to its own defaults (tabs / double quotes / semicolons / line wrapping), which would conflict with the established style and break inline eslint-disable directives. Formatting/linting stay disabled here on purpose; run `npm run lint` (ESLint) for the project's checks.
